subtitle: A Muslim fishing village turned Phuket resort strip, anchored since 1998 by a theme park now restructuring six series of bonds.
spike_statement: Phuket FantaSea, built at Kamala's north end in 1998, survived the 2004 tsunami but has since the pandemic sought repeated bond maturity extensions.

levers.photo_tone: Flat Andaman turquoise past a quiet resort strip, the FantaSea peninsula's gilded rooftops catching late light above the older fishing-village skyline
